description: This file defines the Java exception class 'FeaturePropertyNotAccessibleException' for the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents an error when a requested property of a feature does not exist or access was denied, providing constructors, builders, and parsing methods for this specific exception.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a feature property is inaccessible due to non-existence or insufficient permissions. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException, featuring static factory methods and a builder class.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new builder for constructing instances of FeaturePropertyNotAccessibleException with specific ThingId, featureId, and JSON Pointer.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an instance of FeaturePropertyNotAccessibleException from a simple message string and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of FeaturePropertyNotAccessibleException from a JSON object and DittoHeaders, parsing error details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the given DittoHeaders, copying other properties from the current exception.
